title.narrative: IP Green cities transformation – smart, sustainable and low-carbon urban solutions in triangular metropolitan area (Government cost sharing)

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to start and initiation phase and to develop the project concept into a full GEF IP founded project “Green cities transformation – smart, sustainable and low-carbon urban solutions in triangular metropolitan area”, included necessary studies and mandatory annexes. The proposed GEF IP project would target the triangular metropolitan area comprising the cities of Zrenjanin, Novi Sad (capital of Vojvodina) and Belgrade (capital of Serbia). The project will support pilot interventions for the realization of green, digital, and nature-positive transformation of 3 cities that promote sustainable urban development based on (i) preservation of natural capital and biodiversity, (ii) promotion of multi-sectoral resource and energy efficiency through circular business models and (iii) integrated intra and inter-city spatial planning. These interventions are expected to provide valuable experience by promoting a polycentric approach and developing tailored solutions also for smaller cities.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
